item.description:
Performance improvements:

  • On a network share, the next file's preview no longer waits for the previous file to finish loading.
  • A file shown in both the Finder preview pane and the Quick Look window is loaded only once.
  • Closing a preview stops loading or decompressing almost immediately.
  • MRtrix .mif masks open noticeably faster.
  • With thumbnails enabled, files over 100 MB that would need a full read keep the standard icon instead of slowing down Finder.

Fixes:

  • 64-bit integer images (int64/uint64) in NIfTI, MIF and NRRD now display instead of failing.
  • Improvbed mask detection (some masks rendered as greyscale)
  • If loading all volumes of a 4D file fails, the Volumes line now says so.
  • Fixed a 1.5.1 regression that could distort volumes with extremely small voxel sizes.
  • Images with very small intensity values (e.g. ADC maps in SI units) display with better contrast.
  • The other views no longer show outdated images when scrolling right after adjusting window/level or loading a 4D file's volumes.

Performance improvements:

  • Reopening a file on an unresponsive network share no longer freezes the Quick Look window.
  • Reopening a large file on a network share no longer re-reads the whole file until you scroll or click in the preview.

Fixes:

  • With per-volume windowing on, a timepoint viewed while a 4D .nii.gz was still decompressing could stay stuck in black and white, with window/level not responding.
  • Images with very small intensity values (e.g. ADC maps in SI units) now display with full contrast, and window/level dragging works on them.
  • Compressed files larger than 4 GB no longer crash the preview.
  • Files with zero or invalid voxel sizes now display instead of crashing the preview.
  • Fixed NRRD files that could be misread when their image data contained certain byte patterns.
  • NIfTI-2 files are now labelled "NIfTI-2" in the metadata panel.

New features:

  • Segmentation colouring for Finder thumbnails
  • Support for the MIF Bit datatype (bit-packed masks).

Performance improvements:

  • Segmentation colouring auto by default for preview and thumbnails.
  • Improved handling of NaN and Inf voxels.

Fixes:

  • Fixed MIF anatomical orientation ignoring the transform header, which could mislabel left/right on obliquely-transformed volumes.
  • Minor GUI fixes in the main app
